discussion.title: Distinguish unstarted ticks from committed captures at stop
discussion.status: Lifecycle review integrated. Complete profile and whole-design review remain.
discussion.summary: The owner closes dispatch before acknowledging normal end. Unstarted ticks cancel without attempt ordinals; committed captures retain their real validation and publication outcome. A clean worker stop needs matched intent, acknowledgement, actual exit and published reap. The complete numerical scheduling and resource profile remains outstanding. These diagrams are not model-checking or native evidence.

updatedDiagrams.summary: Defines one owner, bounded pending work and the unresolved finite-profile dependency.
Separates unstarted cancellation, committed capture drain, matched normal exit and unresolved containment.

diagrams.title: One owner controls dispatch and evidence
diagrams.caption: Arrows show ownership, submission and control, and numbered edges mark startup and dispatch entry. The owner authorises operations and writes lifecycle records. Its backend child writes command receipts and the sticky latch under the same lock. The finite caller can take collection-only ownership after owner loss and resolved holders. It never restores scenario eligibility. Numerical profile and implementation remain outstanding.

diagrams.title: Normal stop preserves every committed capture
diagrams.caption: Proposed worker lifecycle. This state view starts at the initial dot. Normal stop never interrupts sleep20, clears failure or replaces a capture. Complete disposition requires backend validation, payload acknowledgement, terminal publication and a completion frame. Stop and reap bounds depend on the remaining finite profile. No native idle interval is established.

diagrams.title: A due capture conflicts with the whole-operation writer
diagrams.caption: Current semantics under a permitted schedule. Twenty seconds is sleep after completion. A live OCR connection maintains VNC activity during that part of the lock hold; validation after CLI exit does not. No collision rate or whole-command deadline follows.

diagrams.title: Agreed timing, evidence, stop and resource scope

diagrams.title: Prepare one window, activate once, then order it
diagrams.caption: Implemented synchronous application order, including readiness failure. The window is constructed and navigation applied before activation. A return does not imply activation completed; the OS may decline. Launch, reopen and both menu callers share this owner. No retry, yielding or deferral is added.
